blocks.text: Blockchain ek digital copy (notebook) ki tarah hai jo group ke har shakhs ke paas hai. Sochiye doston ka ek group hisaab rakhta hai ke kis ne kis ko kitne paise dene hain. Ek kaghaz par likh kar ek dost ke paas rakhne ki bajaye, sab ek aisi copy mein likhte hain jo har ek ke paas hai. Jab bhi koi tabdeeli hoti hai, jaise koi paise wapas karta hai, to woh ek hi waqt mein tamam copies mein likh di jati hai. Blockchain network ke taur par yeh notebook Figure 6.2 mein dikhayi gayi hai (Figure 6.2 agle topic 6.4.1.1 mein hai).
Is digital notebook, yani blockchain, ki kuch khaas khoobiyan hain:

items: Transparency (shaffafiyat): group mein har koi dekh sakta hai ke notebook mein kya likha hai, is liye koi dhoka de ya maloomat chupke se badle to doosron ko pata chal jata hai.

Security (hifazat): ek dafa kuch likh diya jaye to use mitana ya badalna taqreeban na-mumkin hai, kyunke ise cryptography naam ki khaas riyazi (math) technique se mehfooz kiya jata hai jo maloomat ko apni jagah 'lock' kar deti hai.

Decentralization: notebook ka koi ek shakhs ya ek computer incharge nahi. Har ek ke paas barabar copy hai, aur tabdeeli tabhi hoti hai jab aksariyat (majority) maan jaye; is se nizam munsifana aur qabil-e-bharosa banta hai.

blocks.text: Asaan alfaaz mein, blockchain maloomat share karne aur us ka hisaab rakhne ka mehfooz aur shaffaf tareeqa hai, jis mein kisi ek shakhs ya company par bharosa karne ki zaroorat nahi ke woh maloomat sambhal kar rakhe.

blocks.prompt: Sab ke paas copy ho to kisi ek dost ke liye hisaab mein dhoka dena mushkil kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Baqi sab ke paas wahi record hai, is liye us ki tabdeeli foran nazar aa jayegi, aur tabdeeli ke liye aksariyat ki razamandi bhi chahiye.

items: Blockchain: sab ke paas ek jaisi digital copy; har tabdeeli sab copies mein ek saath.
Khoobiyan: transparency, security (cryptography), decentralization (aksariyat ki razamandi).
